main.description: Searches stored titles, descriptions and show host names in subscribed public and viewer-owned private podcasts. No directory requests, PDS hydration or feed fetches. Matching ignores case and diacritics and requires every whitespace-separated term. Results order shows before episodes then stable ID. At most 500 stored rows are scanned per page; a page may be empty with hasMore true. Continue with the opaque cursor until hasMore false. Cursors are bound to viewer, normalized query, kind and showId. Responses are private, no-store. Explicit scope directory searches Podcast Index public names/topics only, never library text or feed URLs. Directory returns candidates (not catalog records), empty shows/episodes, directoryLimit 50, hasMore false and no cursor; at most min(limit,50) public HTTPS podcast candidates from one provider response. No provider pagination or auto subscription. Directory rejects showId/cursor, episode kind, URL or credential-shaped input. Provider fetches have an eight-second deadline, two MiB body cap, exact URL redirect allowlist, public DNS pinning, descriptive User-Agent, no auth headers, five-minute result cache (128 entries), coalescing, two concurrent calls and a self-imposed 20 cache misses/minute per AppView process. Procedure (POST) so private viewer search text stays out of URLs and access logs.
